pairs.question: Parce Domine populo tuo et ne des hereditatem tuam in obprobrium ut dominentur eis nationes quare dicunt in populis ubi est Deus eorum?
pairs.answer: Ecce ego mittam vobis frumentum et vinum et oleum et replebimini eo et non dabo vos ultra obprobrium in gentibus.
pairs.derivation: The priests' prayer (v17) is quoted after the framing tag 'et dicent'; it ends with the interrogative taunt 'quare dicunt in populis ubi est Deus eorum'. God's reply is introduced by the explicit speech verb 'et respondit Dominus et dixit populo suo' (framing, dropped) in v19. Answer window starts at the operative 'ecce ego mittam...' and stops at the first full stop ('...in gentibus'); the following v20 ('et eum qui ab aquilone...') turns to elaboration on the enemy and is cut.
